🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 9, 2026

Moon, in Libra, holds an opposition to Neptune, in Aries. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. Mars has been out of Cancer for four weeks now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Venus turned back a week ago; the review is still running.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. Mercury has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Libra untitled. Sun in Libra stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Cardinal water meets a bill. The square of three weeks ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you from Libra, where it stands lowest. Moon sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Since Sun crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Venus in Scorpio leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Mutable earth keeps two accounts, and both balance. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Cardinal air opens and closes the same file. 7° in a month for Venus, and a month is not long for it.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Mercury is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds until owning and being coincide. Sun let go of it two weeks ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. From Libra, Moon hands you an opening. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Libra, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth moves first and pays first. The trine to Jupiter that held two weeks ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.
